newsitem.title: UK: Bass down, towards low end of recent range.
newsitem.headline: Bass down, towards low end of recent range.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc drifted lower on Thursday, extending recent losses amid concern over the planned Carlsberg-Tetley acquisition and talk of continued margin pressure in the brewing industry, traders said.
One said a line of some five million Bass shares that was recently on offer was yet to be placed.
"There is a block of shares with nowhere to go and when the market is a bit drifty Bass is one of the first stocks to go lower," the trader said.
Bass shares were down 12-1/2p at 777-1/2 at the close of trading in London, towards the low end of its recent trading range between about 763p and 850p.
